title: Michael Rulli Stock Trades: Microsoft and Wells Fargo Sales, Goldman Sachs Purchase (Oct 2026)
content:
Rep. Michael Rulli (OH-06) disclosed three trades on October 2, 2026: sales of Microsoft (MSFT) and Wells Fargo (WFC) and a purchase of Goldman Sachs (GS).

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

TickerCompanyTransaction dateType / size
MSFTMicrosoft CorporationSep 28, 2026Sale, $1,001–$15,000
WFCWells Fargo & CompanySep 3, 2026Sale, $1,001–$15,000
GSGoldman Sachs Group, Inc.Sep 3, 2026Purchase, $1,001–$15,000

Disclosure date for all three: Oct 2, 2026 (4 to 29 days after the trades). Member: Rep. Michael Rulli, OH-06 (House).

What's been disclosed

  • Two sales: Microsoft on September 28 and Wells Fargo on September 3, each $1,001–$15,000.
  • One purchase: Goldman Sachs on September 3, $1,001–$15,000.
  • Price data: Bargo lists no price estimates for these three trades, so no price comparison is shown.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
4 days for the Microsoft sale and 29 days for the Wells Fargo sale and Goldman Sachs purchase. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $1,001–$15,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Why is there no price comparison?
Bargo's price fields are empty for all three trades, so we do not show one.
